newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian pupils protest over cold classrooms.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian pupils protest over cold classrooms.

text.p: Pupils from a technical high school blocked a main road out of Sofia on Wednesday to protest at lack of heating, witnesses said.
Police directed traffic around the protest and the students from the Chemical Industry and Biotechnology High School dispersed after about 1-1/2 hours.
The protesters distributed copies of a letter from the school's director to Education Minister Ilcho Dimitrov protesting that teachers' wages were paid late and classrooms were too cold.
Dimitrov said in a recent television interview his ministry was doing its best to resolve severe problems with heating oil supplies to schools.
High inflation and a fall in the national currency have increased the price of oil imports and the heavily-indebted government lacks funds to pay its bills.
